title: ASImposium session-protocol contracts
description: Fable §7 session loop: open, pack, workshop push, promote, close. Writes are JSON only; packs are budgeted with mandatory omitted[] and server-authored next_actions.

target_id.description: Object ID within the session problem; statement anchors use the problem ID.

target_version.description: When supplied, the referenced event must carry this exact object version.

target_seq.description: When supplied, the exact same-problem event sequence, at or before covers_through. All supplied pins must match one event. Statement events are admission or statement revision.

promote_request.statement: Every toggle-invariant labeling of the 4-path factors through the quotient by the orientation-reversing involution.
promote_request.falsifier: A labeling of the 4-path that is toggle-invariant but does not factor through that quotient.

workshop_push_request.title: Narrow the range in C-1
workshop_push_request.body_md: Private notes about the attempted generalization.

revision.statement: The orbit count is invariant under all eight toggles for n > 2.
revision.falsifier: A toggle sequence changing the orbit count for an n > 2.
